cards.consumerAndFactSource: Life.step/stepEntity consume current world entities and formal simulation state; writes through existing life simulation methods.
cards.settlementObjects: Per active entity passed by existing Life loop; no additional global set is authorized.
cards.timePrecision: Existing simulation step and due actions.
cards.worstCaseCost: Inherited baseline cost; one step can visit the current Life entity set. Any added work must state a hard per-call object bound and order.
cards.queryMethod: Existing Life iteration and spatial helpers; new consumers must use current entity/local references.
cards.rngContract: Preserve existing named stream call order; no diagnostic or observational draws.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No new cache authorized; dynamic dependencies must be revalidated at use.
cards.dataLifetime: Existing world/save state only; no new persistent fields without separate save review.
cards.failureAndExit: Respect death, ascension, possession, removal, and existing step cancellation.
cards.testEvidence: Baseline anchor only; future changes require controlled boundaries, deterministic/RNG and save evidence plus measured call counts.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: advanceWorld reads World and invokes existing simulation phase entry points.
cards.settlementObjects: World-level phases plus configured Life entities and existing active collections.
cards.timePrecision: Requested simulation advancement and formal phase/day boundaries.
cards.worstCaseCost: Inherited baseline; document each newly added phase bound and avoid nested full-world scans.
cards.queryMethod: Existing subsystem entry points and indexes; no duplicate population cache.
cards.rngContract: Keep existing stream ownership and ordering across save/restore.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No new cache authorized unless every mutable dependency and invalidation is listed.
cards.dataLifetime: Existing world fields and save protocol; no metrics persisted.
cards.failureAndExit: Stop or skip phases under existing world/object lifecycle and cancellation rules.
cards.testEvidence: Baseline anchor only; future change requires phase/RNG/save equivalence and bounded controlled fixture.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: stepSkillResources reads entity skill/profile and existing resource state; writes via established skill/resource mutations.
cards.settlementObjects: One eligible entity per invocation; eligibility must reject unqualified entities before profile initialization.
cards.worstCaseCost: Bound to one entity's existing skill/resource collections; no population scan or repeated full effect evaluation.
cards.queryMethod: Direct entity reference and existing skill collections.
cards.rngContract: No new RNG for qualification/maintenance; preserve current stream behavior for actual skill outcomes.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cache; qualify against current entity and legacy combat/equipment state.
cards.dataLifetime: Existing profile/save representation; preserve legacy assigned skills and old state.
cards.failureAndExit: Death, ascension, possession, missing profile, and ineligible legacy entities exit without initialization.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled mortal/cultivator/legacy/possession fixtures; deterministic save round trip and call-count evidence.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: Opt-in WeakMap metrics observe calls from existing simulation consumers; never write World facts.
cards.settlementObjects: Only explicitly enabled World instance and supplied scalar labels/counts.
cards.worstCaseCost: Disabled path one opt-in check; enabled path bounded metric updates per instrumented call, no entity enumeration.
cards.queryMethod: WeakMap lookup by World object; snapshots copy bounded metric records.
cards.cacheInvalidation: WeakMap ownership follows World lifetime; explicit disable/reset clears measurement state.
cards.dataLifetime: Diagnostic-only ephemeral memory; excluded from save/profile/runtime world state.
cards.failureAndExit: Uses global performance.now() directly when enabled; no missing-clock fallback is implemented. Disable and world collection release metrics.
cards.testEvidence: Enabled/disabled same-world and RNG equivalence; bounded snapshot; disabled overhead microcheck.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: readEffects reads current entity/world facts and returns a derived effect view.
cards.settlementObjects: One requested entity and its explicitly referenced local dependencies.
cards.timePrecision: Caller query; existing callers determine frequency.
cards.worstCaseCost: Bound to one entity's declared effect/state lists; no new whole-population traversal.
cards.queryMethod: Direct entity reference plus existing ID/local lookups.
cards.rngContract: Pure read; no RNG draw or stream mutation.
cards.cacheInvalidation: Do not cache complete dynamic output without invalidating every condition, target, position, relation, and injury dependency.
cards.dataLifetime: Derived result is transient; no save changes.
cards.failureAndExit: Missing/dead/unavailable target follows existing effect semantics and returns safely.
cards.testEvidence: Purity/RNG checks, relevant dynamic dependency changes, and read call-count measurement.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: main.update reads current runtime/world state and dispatches existing simulation/render updates.
cards.settlementObjects: Existing visible/runtime world; no additional all-world consumer permitted.
cards.timePrecision: Frame/rAF update; new simulation consumers are prohibited here unless a bounded explicit exception is approved.
cards.worstCaseCost: Inherited baseline; any exception must give strict per-frame object and time bounds.
cards.queryMethod: Existing frame-local references and render indexes.
cards.rngContract: Rendering/observation adds no simulation RNG draws.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No new cross-frame cache without explicit complete invalidation.
cards.dataLifetime: Transient runtime state; no new save fields.
cards.failureAndExit: Pause, teardown, world replacement, and hidden/inactive view stop optional work.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled frame-call assertions, no extra simulation changes, and measured bounded work.

cards.riskClass: B: can change which existing site becomes the next target; this is a behavior change and must be assessed with replay/availability evidence.
cards.consumerAndFactSource: Planned planNext destination reselection scans existing world.sites and reads site fields plus nearby cave/artifact content through siteHasContent; arrival and rewards remain owned by existing site consumers.
cards.settlementObjects: One planning entity and world.sites; only formations and caves for which siteHasContent is false are excluded. Secret realms and ruins remain eligible for their existing generic rewards.
cards.timePrecision: Only when planNext reselects a destination; not per frame or on every step.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(S + nearby cave/artifact content checks), where S is the full world.sites length. Radius 30. No hard candidate-count cap, to avoid changing reachability. No saved search index or history scan.
cards.queryMethod: One linear scan of the existing world.sites array and local radius checks. No persistent active-site index. siteHasContent validates nearby cave/artifact content using existing official objects.
cards.rngContract: Filtering/search adds no RNG draws. Preserve the existing downstream choice/tie RNG path; ties retain the array's existing order where the existing chooser is stable. Any changed or additional draw is a reviewed B-class behavior change.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cross-call cache; each reselection reads current positions, site state, artifact ownership/content, and entity location.
cards.dataLifetime: No new persistent or warm/cold search data; only existing selected-target plan state is retained.
cards.failureAndExit: A result is a nearby candidate, not proof of path reachability; current planNext does not run pathfinding here. Missing or stale sites are handled by existing planning/arrival behavior; no new cancellation protocol is introduced.
cards.testEvidence: Controlled empty/content-bearing cave, secret/ruin generic reward, radius boundary, array-order tie, stale target, deterministic RNG-path and save/replay checks; implementation review pending.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: Existing sim/sites.js reads and updates world.sites, artifact ownership/content and formal site outcomes; planned delta only adds counters at formal submission points.
cards.settlementObjects: Existing site records as traversed by their current lifecycle/encounter callers.
cards.timePrecision: Existing site lifecycle and committed outcome points.
cards.worstCaseCost: Baseline traversal/search costs remain unchanged; diagnostic increment is O(1) per formal point, with no added scan.
cards.queryMethod: Existing world.sites array and current nearby/content checks; this counter change creates no index.
cards.rngContract: Counters add no RNG draws and do not affect site creation/expiry/reward decisions.
cards.dataLifetime: Diagnostic counters are opt-in ephemeral metrics; no save/schema change.
cards.failureAndExit: Existing site expiry/removal and encounter exit behavior are unchanged; counters only observe submitted points.
cards.testEvidence: Counter unit fixture at formal submission points plus deterministic world/site and save equivalence.

cards.consumerAndFactSource: Existing wanxiang/damage.js manaCapacity(entity) reads entity's current active devour skill state and returns capacity; planned delta optionally counts calls through supplied diagnostic context.
cards.settlementObjects: One queried entity per capacity evaluation.
cards.timePrecision: Only existing direct caller evaluations; optional counter observes calls without adding new evaluation sites.
cards.worstCaseCost: O(1) existing state check and optional O(1) count increment per call; no entity traversal.
cards.queryMethod: Direct entity reference and current active-skill lookup.
cards.rngContract: No RNG draws; capacity result is unchanged.
cards.cacheInvalidation: No cached capacity; reads current active devour state each call.
cards.dataLifetime: Optional count belongs to opt-in ephemeral diagnostics only; no entity/save field.
cards.failureAndExit: Missing/legacy skill data follows current active(e, 'devour') behavior; no new initialization or exit state.
cards.testEvidence: With/without diagnostic context capacity result and RNG/world equality; exact optional call-count assertion.
